g.text: Member C - Accepted evidence and independent review
Accepted order block before proposal -> manual-only target;
missing facts -> Coordinator; technical errors -> bounded recovery.
The loop below requires an admissible current input.
[First admitted round; repeat iff admitted REVISE and budget remains]
Read authorised full current input / source facts
Original statements, order lookup, scoped attachments
Submit receipt with source/work bindings [CS A02]
Validate and accept original source observation
No new current proposal; actual typed failure
Preserve history; never truncate to preview or invent source text.
Select current work/round/invocation; load accepted review input
No Assessment hidden reasoning. Evidence matrix is an interpretation.
Original sources, order and statements remain independent comparison material.
C2 cannot edit packet, write state, approve or call providers.
Atomic guard on work / round / invocation and current context
No change to newer round / business audit outcome
Retire selected invocation; bounded retry or failure handling
Retry / exhaustion must match the selected failed invocation.
A late failure event cannot retire a newer same-version retry.
A retry uses a newly selected invocation; never synthesize PASS.
Store valid RiskReview and exact proposal history ref + audit
Current packet and visible warnings; no execution authority
Schedule new proposal_version with specific corrections
Old result retained, no old approval carried forward.
Leave machine loop; accepted answer changes input, then new proposal/review.
Explicit risk / bound reason, no direct approval
Current proposal: valid REQUEST_REVISION or MANUAL_HANDLING.
MANUAL_HANDLING only; no fabricated RiskReview or proposal.
Loop repeats only for an admitted revision; all other branches yield/stop this episode.
Method labels describe internal messages, not new wire fields or public HTTP routes.
All state-changing events (reply, timeout, invalidation, retry, exhaustion) use atomic identity guards.
AI-assisted refinement of the shared report discussion candidate; runtime and A/C review pending.
